source: ECCD Council — Table of Scaled Scores and Standard Scores; How to Use / Guidebook interpretation bands
notes: Scaled score tables map domain raw score ranges → scaled score 1–19, by child age band.
Domain order in tables: GM, FM, SH, RL, EL, COG, SE.
Tables are filled incrementally; empty age bands return null scaled scores until digitized.
Interpretation bands below are official (ECCD Checklist Manual / Guidebook).
